Feed mole fractions, from a 100 g basis:
n1 = 30/78.11 = 0.38407 mol, n2 = 40/92.14 = 0.43412 mol, n3 = 30/106.17 = 0.28257 mol; total = 1.10076 mol.
z1 = 0.34892, z2 = 0.39438, z3 = 0.25670.
P = 120 kPa = 120/0.133322 = 900.08 mmHg.

(a) Bubble point: sum of z_i*P_i^sat(T) = P = 900.08 mmHg.
At 100 °C: P^sat = (1350.5, 556.3, 198.5) mmHg; weighted sum = 741.6 mmHg.
At 110 °C: P^sat = (1756.4, 746.6, 277.2) mmHg; weighted sum = 978.5 mmHg.
At 107 °C: P^sat = (1625.9, 684.7, 251.4) mmHg; weighted sum = 901.9 mmHg.
The sum decreases by about 24.7 mmHg per °C near 107 °C, so the root is at 107 - 1.8/24.7 = 106.93 °C.

(b) Dew point: sum of z_i/P_i^sat(T) = 1/P = 1.1110e-3 per mmHg.
At 120 °C: P^sat = (2249.3, 984.7, 379.8) mmHg; sum = 1.2315e-3 per mmHg.
At 130 °C: P^sat = (2840.4, 1278.4, 510.6) mmHg; sum = 0.9340e-3 per mmHg.
At 124 °C: P^sat = (2473.2, 1095.1, 428.5) mmHg; sum = 1.1003e-3 per mmHg.
Correction with dS/dT = -3.06e-5 per mmHg per °C gives T = 124 - 0.35 = 123.65 °C.

(c) Flash at 112 °C: P^sat = (1847.7, 790.2, 295.8) mmHg, so K = (2.0528, 0.8779, 0.3286).
Rachford-Rice: f(V) = sum of z_i*(K_i-1)/(1+V*(K_i-1)) = 0.
f(0.30) = +0.01337 and f(0.35) = -0.00716; interpolation and one refinement give V = 0.3326.

(d) y1 = z1*K1/(1+V*(K1-1)) = 0.34892*2.0528/1.3501 = 0.5305.

(e) Half vaporized: f(0.5) = 0, i.e. sum of z_i*(K_i-1)/(K_i+1) = 0.
The sum is -0.03503 at 112 °C, +0.00206 at 115 °C and +0.03873 at 118 °C.
Interpolation between 112 and 115 °C, refined at 114.8 °C where the sum is +0.00001, gives T = 114.80 °C.

FINAL (a): 106.93 °C
FINAL (b): 123.65 °C
FINAL (c): 0.3326 dimensionless
FINAL (d): 0.5305 dimensionless
FINAL (e): 114.80 °C
